        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Data delivery area, possible values are: <code>mainland</code>: within mainland China; <code>overseas</code>: worldwide (excluding mainland China).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_cls_go">

    </dt>
    <dd>CLS configuration information. This parameter is required when TaskType is cls.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_customendpoint_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_customendpoint_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Custom<wbr>Endpoint</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverycustomendpoint">Realtime<wbr>Log<wbr>Delivery<wbr>Custom<wbr>Endpoint<wbr>Args</a></span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverycustomfield">[]Realtime<wbr>Log<wbr>Delivery<wbr>Custom<wbr>Field<wbr>Args</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The list of custom fields delivered supports extracting specified field values from HTTP request headers, response headers, and cookies. Custom field names cannot be repeated and cannot exceed 200 fields.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deliveryconditions_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deliveryconditions_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Delivery<wbr>Conditions</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

    <dd>The filter condition for log delivery. If it is not filled, all logs will be delivered.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deliverystatus_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The status of the real-time log delivery task. The values are: <code>enabled</code>: enabled; <code>disabled</code>: disabled. Leave it blank to keep the original configuration. Not required when creating.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_entitylists_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_entitylists_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Entity<wbr>Lists</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">[]string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>List of entities (seven-layer domain names or four-layer proxy instances) corresponding to real-time log delivery tasks. Example values are as follows: Seven-layer domain name: <code>domain.example.com</code>; four-layer proxy instance: sid-2s69eb5wcms7. For values, refer to: <code>https://cloud.tencent.com/document/api/1552/80690</code>, <code>https://cloud.tencent.com/document/api/1552/86336</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_fields_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_fields_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Fields</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">[]string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A list of preset fields for delivery.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_logformat_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_logformat_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Log<wbr>Format</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverylogformat">Realtime<wbr>Log<wbr>Delivery<wbr>Log<wbr>Format<wbr>Args</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The output format of log delivery. If it is not filled, it means the default format. The default format logic is as follows: when TaskType is <code>customEndpoint</code>, the default format is an array of multiple JSON objects, each JSON object is a log; when TaskType is <code>s3</code>, the default format is JSON Lines; in particular, when TaskType is <code>cls</code>, the value of LogFormat.FormatType can only be json, and other parameters in LogFormat will be ignored. It is recommended not to pass LogFormat.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Data delivery type, the values are: <code>domain</code>: site acceleration log; <code>application</code>: four-layer proxy log; <code>web-rateLiming</code>: rate limit and CC attack protection log; <code>web-attack</code>: managed rule log; <code>web-rule</code>: custom rule log; <code>web-bot</code>: Bot management log.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_s3_go">

    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_sample_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The sampling ratio is in thousandths, with a value range of 1-1000. For example, filling in 605 means the sampling ratio is 60.5%. Leaving it blank means the sampling ratio is 100%.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_taskid_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_taskid_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Task<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_taskname_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The name of the real-time log delivery task. The format is a combination of numbers, English, -, and _. The maximum length is 200 characters.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_tasktype_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_tasktype_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Task<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The real-time log delivery task type. The possible values are: <code>cls</code>: push to Tencent Cloud CLS; <code>customEndpoint</code>: push to a custom HTTP(S) address; <code>s3</code>: push to an AWS S3 compatible storage bucket address; <code>logAnalysis</code>: push to EdgeOne log analysis.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deliveryconditions_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">delivery<wbr>Conditions</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverydeliverycondition">List&lt;Property Map&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The filter condition for log delivery. If it is not filled, all logs will be delivered.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deliverystatus_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deliverystatus_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">delivery<wbr>Status</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The status of the real-time log delivery task. The values are: <code>enabled</code>: enabled; <code>disabled</code>: disabled. Leave it blank to keep the original configuration. Not required when creating.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_entitylists_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_entitylists_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">entity<wbr>Lists</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>List of entities (seven-layer domain names or four-layer proxy instances) corresponding to real-time log delivery tasks. Example values are as follows: Seven-layer domain name: <code>domain.example.com</code>; four-layer proxy instance: sid-2s69eb5wcms7. For values, refer to: <code>https://cloud.tencent.com/document/api/1552/80690</code>, <code>https://cloud.tencent.com/document/api/1552/86336</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_fields_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_fields_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">fields</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A list of preset fields for delivery.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_logformat_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_logformat_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">log<wbr>Format</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverylogformat">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The output format of log delivery. If it is not filled, it means the default format. The default format logic is as follows: when TaskType is <code>customEndpoint</code>, the default format is an array of multiple JSON objects, each JSON object is a log; when TaskType is <code>s3</code>, the default format is JSON Lines; in particular, when TaskType is <code>cls</code>, the value of LogFormat.FormatType can only be json, and other parameters in LogFormat will be ignored. It is recommended not to pass LogFormat.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_logtype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_logtype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">log<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Data delivery type, the values are: <code>domain</code>: site acceleration log; <code>application</code>: four-layer proxy log; <code>web-rateLiming</code>: rate limit and CC attack protection log; <code>web-attack</code>: managed rule log; <code>web-rule</code>: custom rule log; <code>web-bot</code>: Bot management log.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_s3_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_s3_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">s3</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#realtimelogdeliverys3">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Configuration information of AWS S3 compatible storage bucket. This parameter is required when TaskType is s3.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_sample_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_sample_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">sample</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The sampling ratio is in thousandths, with a value range of 1-1000. For example, filling in 605 means the sampling ratio is 60.5%. Leaving it blank means the sampling ratio is 100%.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_taskid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_taskid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">task<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Real-time log delivery task ID.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_taskname_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_taskname_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">task<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The name of the real-time log delivery task. The format is a combination of numbers, English, -, and _. The maximum length is 200 characters.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_tasktype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_tasktype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">task<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The real-time log delivery task type. The possible values are: <code>cls</code>: push to Tencent Cloud CLS; <code>customEndpoint</code>: push to a custom HTTP(S) address; <code>s3</code>: push to an AWS S3 compatible storage bucket address; <code>logAnalysis</code>: push to EdgeOne log analysis.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_zoneid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_zoneid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">zone<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>ID of the site.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

    <dd>Log filtering conditions, the detailed filtering conditions are as follows: - <code>EdgeResponseStatusCode</code>: filter according to the status code returned by the EdgeOne node to the client. Supported operators: <code>equal</code>, <code>great</code>, <code>less</code>, <code>greatEqual</code>, <code>lessEqual</code>; Value range: any integer greater than or equal to 0; - <code>OriginResponseStatusCode</code>: filter according to the origin response status code. Supported operators: <code>equal</code>, <code>great</code>, <code>less</code>, <code>greatEqual</code>, <code>lessEqual</code>; Value range: any integer greater than or equal to -1; - <code>SecurityAction</code>: filter according to the final disposal action after the request hits the security rule. Supported operators: <code>equal</code>; Optional options are as follows: <code>-</code>: unknown/miss; <code>Monitor</code>: observe; <code>JSChallenge</code>: JavaScript challenge; <code>Deny</code>: intercept; <code>Allow</code>: allow; <code>BlockIP</code>: IP ban; <code>Redirect</code>: redirect; <code>ReturnCustomPage</code>: return to a custom page; <code>ManagedChallenge</code>: managed challenge; <code>Silence</code>: silent; <code>LongDelay</code>: respond after a long wait; <code>ShortDelay</code>: respond after a short wait; -<code>SecurityModule</code>: filter according to the name of the security module that finally handles the request. Supported operators: <code>equal</code>; Optional options: <code>-</code>: unknown/missed; <code>CustomRule</code>: Web Protection - Custom Rules; <code>RateLimitingCustomRule</code>: Web Protection - Rate Limiting Rules; <code>ManagedRule</code>: Web Protection - Managed Rules; <code>L7DDoS</code>: Web Protection - CC Attack Protection; <code>BotManagement</code>: Bot Management - Bot Basic Management; <code>BotClientReputation</code>: Bot Management - Client Profile Analysis; <code>BotBehaviorAnalysis</code>: Bot Management - Bot Intelligent Analysis; <code>BotCustomRule</code>: Bot Management - Custom Bot Rules; <code>BotActiveDetection</code>: Bot Management - Active Feature Recognition.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

